# Upcoming changes in Patch 42 on February 28, 2023

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_127_nukaknights-post-patch42-aenderungen.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

On **Tuesday, February 28th, 2023** it's that time again. The next **Update** (Patch 42) brings some innovations to the live game Fallout 76. You could now see and test a lot of things on the PTS and in the game files of the PTS. Anyone who has followed our posts probably already knows a lot of things. Here is the summary of the changes again.

## Daily Operations: New mutation "Reflective"

Enemies here change states to Reflective and Normal at intervals of **5 seconds**. Once they are **Reflective** there is a **bright glowing effect** on them. Once they are reflective, that means they **reflect some of the damage dealt back to you**. In plain language: if you damage enemies in this state, you yourself will die.

But there is one exception: the **mutation ignores explosions**. This means you can inflict damage with explosive weapons or grenades without taking damage yourself. 

Other ways to deal damage to reflective enemies are: **Throwing weapons** & the perk "**Down through the middle**" under Strength ("Deal damage to enemies and stagger them by sprinting against them with power armor").

This is what it looks like when the opponents change states:

The best way to deal with the Reflective Mutation is the **Automatic Grenade Launcher (AGL)** e.g. the **Nuka thrower** from the season (double shot is the best choice for the AGL here) or the **thirst quencher** from Nuka World. Since the mutation doesn't reflect the damage from explosions, you're significantly better off with it than with any other firearm. One advantage of the AGL over the Thirst Quencher is that you get concept-related ammunition back.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-dailyops-reflective-aliens-uplink-youtube.jpg)

See also: PTS: New Enemies Mutation: Reflective / Reflective in Daily Operations and Mutated Events

![](/uploads/handmade-hotrod-dailyops.png) 

See also: All about Daily Operations

## Mutated events

The main change to the events is that the opponents in the event have a mutation. You already know the mutation from daily operations.

The **Mutated Events continue to take place once on the hour**, with normal public events continuing to take place in between. In double mutation events, the opponents have 2 mutations as in daily operations. An announcement for a mutated event looks like this:

![](/uploads/dailyops-mutated-event-info-crop.png)

The following events can currently spawn as mutated events:

- **A night full of violence** / One violent night
- **Against the Sound Barrier** / Line in the Sand
- **Hardness test** / Test your metal
- **Heart of the Swamp** / Heart of the Swamp
- **Danger of collapse** / Lore Baring
- **Guided Meditation** / Guided Meditation
- **Eviction Notice** / Eviction Notice
- **Moonshine Jamo** / Moonshine Jamo
